acceptanceCriteria: Record a three-stage matrix for active PR archived PR and ordinary or post-merge CI with explicit unknown-route failure before implementation
Active PR retains real candidate Runtime producer then Rust Contract gate then formal receipt consumer and package coverage

Archived PR executes the existing read-only Rust Contract gate against the source checkout and independently executes repository gates and package coverage on the current head without stale hosted receipt variables or cleanup assumptions
Ordinary PR and post-merge routes keep their existing required checks; unknown selection methods fail closed without unconditional gate skipping
Focused RED to GREEN regressions and full declared Runtime verification pass; preserve PR 1012 failed runs and require new exact-head hosted CI evidence for this fix without claiming PR 1012 merged
goal: Route active PRs through candidate hosted verification and formal receipt consumption; route archived PRs through the existing read-only Rust Contract gate plus fresh repository/package coverage; preserve ordinary PR and post-merge behavior and fail closed for unknown routes
guidelines: Active pull_request selection uses a real candidate hosted Runtime verification producer, then Rust Contract gate, then formal receipt-backed repository package coverage.

Archived pull_request selection uses the existing read-only Rust Contract gate on the checked-out source plus fresh repository gates and package coverage; it does not start preflight or verification or consume a historical hosted receipt.
Ordinary pull_request and post-merge push preserve current repository gate and package coverage behavior; unknown or contradictory selection methods fail closed.
Keep PR #1012 and its active-head success and archived-head failures unchanged; this WI neither merges that PR nor grants merger authority.
intent: Repair CI lifecycle routing for archived PR Contracts without weakening active or ordinary gates
outOfScope: No Runtime protocol changes; no archived Contract or evidence mutation; no merge of PR 1012 or this WI without separate Ray authorization; no fabricated hosted receipt; no global gate bypass

scenarioCoverage.scenario: archived PR read-only gate and fresh package coverage
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise the archived selection fixture through workflow regression and inspect an exact-head PR run for Rust gate and repository package coverage execution with no hosted producer.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Ordinary PR and post-merge routes keep their required repository checks and package coverage with no Contract-hosted receipt assumption.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: ordinary PR and post-merge routes retain required coverage
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run existing route and repository gate regressions for ordinary pull_request and main push fixtures, then inspect hosted route and gate receipts.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: unknown or contradictory selection fails closed
